test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows receipts and expenditure of a business firm over 5 years. Gain = Receipts - Expenditure.

What is the increase percentage in receipts from 2017 to 2018?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bcf667de16caddaaa86a92f792219d95f2fd4443b0139a80617ba379a240fad.png]
solution:
**Given:**

The following bar graph shows the receipts and expenditures of a business firm over 5 years.

**Calculation:**

The increase in receipts from 2017 to 2018 (in lakhs) = 80 - 64 = 16

The increase percentage = (16/64) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The increasing percentage in receipts is 25% from 2017 to 2018**
